entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: A non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: An industry consortium creating open standards for 3D graphics and parallel computing.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: A royalty-free specification for the efficient transmission and loading of 3D scenes and models.

entities.name: AOUSD
entities.note: The Alliance for OpenUSD promotes the standardization and evolution of OpenUSD.

entities.name: OpenUSD
entities.note: A high-performance 3D scene description framework originally developed by Pixar.

entities.name: OpenXR
entities.note: A royalty-free, open standard that provides high-performance access to augmented and virtual reality platforms.

entities.name: WebXR
entities.note: An API for accessing virtual reality and augmented reality devices in web browsers.

entities.name: WebGPU
entities.note: A modern web API providing advanced 3D graphics and computation capabilities.

entities.name: WebGL
entities.note: A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics within any compatible web browser.

entities.name: three.js
entities.note: A popular cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics.

entities.name: Babylon.js
entities.note: A powerful, simple, and open game and rendering engine packed into a friendly JavaScript framework.

entities.name: A-Frame
entities.note: A web framework for building virtual reality experiences, built on top of HTML and three.js.

entities.name: OGC
entities.note: The Open Geospatial Consortium is an international organization committed to making quality geospatial information accessible.

entities.name: 3D Tiles
entities.note: An OGC standard designed for streaming and rendering massive 3D geospatial datasets.

entities.name: CesiumJS
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript library for creating world-class 3D globes and maps.

entities.name: Cesium
entities.note: A company and platform focused on 3D geospatial software and data.

entities.name: buildingSMART
entities.note: The worldwide industry body driving the digital transformation of the built asset industry.

entities.name: IFC
entities.note: Industry Foundation Classes is a standardized, digital description of the built asset industry.

entities.name: PlayCanvas
entities.note: An open-source 3D game engine and interactive web application framework.

entities.name: Unreal Engine
entities.note: A highly advanced real-time 3D creation tool developed by Epic Games.

entities.name: Unity
entities.note: A widely used cross-platform game engine developed by Unity Technologies.

entities.name: Blender
entities.note: A free and open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset.

entities.name: NVIDIA Omniverse
entities.note: A computing platform that enables individuals and teams to develop Universal Scene Description (OpenUSD) based 3D workflows.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source framework and runtime for 3D graphics on the Web that integrates X3D into the HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A standard-compliant X3D and VRML player for web browsers.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: An open-source cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D and VRML.

entities.name: Inline
entities.note: An X3D node used to embed another X3D scene or glTF model into the current scene.

entities.name: CADGeometry
entities.note: An X3D component that provides nodes for representing Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models.

entities.name: Geospatial
entities.note: An X3D component for representing geographic and geospatial data.

entities.name: W3C
entities.note: The World Wide Web Consortium is the main international standards organization for the World Wide Web.

entities.name: glTF-Blender-IO
entities.note: The official glTF 2.0 importer and exporter for Blender.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: An authoring tool for creating and editing X3D scenes.

entities.name: H-Anim
entities.note: A standard for representing humanoids in 3D environments, tightly integrated with X3D.

entities.name: Metaverse Standards Forum
entities.note: A venue for cooperation between standards organizations and companies to foster metaverse interoperability.

entities.name: WebVR
entities.note: A deprecated experimental JavaScript API that provided support for virtual reality devices, superseded by WebXR.
